p: Will miss the Week 9 game vs. Seattle; the length of the absence is uncertain.
The left tackle is out, which weakens pass protection and the run game for the Arizona offense this week.
Bam Knight and Jayden Williams will all be out.
Williams left with a knee injury and did not return; LaFleur still has a lot of trust in him long-term.
His absence affects the left tackle spot and pass protection.
The coach defended the tackle against Denver's pass rush but wants better chip help, a sign pass protection is a concern for the QB.
I thought he did some good stuff against one of the premier pass rushers
